project_info.theme: Chinese New Year discovery at Times Square
project_info.color_palette: lantern red, lion-dance gold, neon white, midnight blue, warm beige

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with shoulder-length dark hair and round gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a cream knit sweater.

items: lion dancers and crowd behind the subject

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: mixed Times Square LED signage and lantern light, approximately 3000K to 6500K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: lively night exposure with authentic handheld movement and a festive crowd atmosphere

technical_specs.render_style: vertical phone selfie video, natural front-camera perspective, slight handheld motion

prompt.generated_prompt_string: An adult woman films from the angle of holding up her phone to take a selfie. She occasionally glances around as if hoping to find signs of Chinese New Year in New York, saying while she walks: 'I hope I'm lucky enough to see people celebrating Chinese New Year in Times Square.' Then she spots something and runs over, exclaiming: 'This is it. This is my first Spring Festival in New York.' Behind her, the lively sounds of a lion dance performance fill the air, creating a festive, bustling atmosphere full of the spirit of Chinese New Year.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, watermark, distorted face, extra fingers, garbled text
